name: Mishima (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mishima village emblem in red and green: a red disc crossed by green horizontal strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mishima, a village in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 August 1983.

features.role: Mishima village emblem — a red disc crossed by green horizontal strokes, like a stylised character
